title: Typed messages on a pipe
description:
Frame messages with a type and length so the reader always knows where one ends.

```
send Hello{"ada"}     -> 01 00 00 00 03 61 64 61
send Ping             -> 02 00 00 00 00
reader got: Hello ada, Ping
unknown type 7: skipped 3 bytes and carried on
```
hints: Wait until `m_pending.size() >= 5`, read the length, then wait until `5 + length` bytes are there (lesson 2.03).
Skipping an unknown type is easy only because of the length field; that is what makes the protocol extendable.
requirements: Header: one type byte and a 4-byte little-endian length.
The reader handles messages split across reads and skips unknown types using the length.
stretch: Use `PIPE_TYPE_MESSAGE` mode in a real named pipe and see how it changes reading.
